Calibrate a catchment from start to finish in one call

Source: R/calibrate_project.R
calibrate_project.Rd

Runs the whole logged calibration of Calibrating a catchment from start to finish for one set of prepared data: start_calibration_project(), register_data(), select_structure(), recommend_structure() when recommend = TRUE, log_staged_calibration(), propose_candidate(), validate_candidate() when a validation window is registered, and test_candidate() when a test window or wettest years are. Each step is an entry in the project's log, as if made by hand.

Usage

calibrate_project(
  project,
  forcing,
  observed,
  area_km2,
  calibration,
  validation = NULL,
  structure = NULL,
  stages = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  recommend = FALSE,
  overrides = NULL,
  exclude = NULL,
  cores = 1L,
  starts = 2L,
  seed = 1L,
  control = list(maxit = 40L),
  method = "lbfgsb",
  catchment = basename(project),
  gauge = catchment,
  purpose = "PDM calibration",
  owner = NULL,
  steward = NULL,
  report = FALSE,
  zones = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

project

Folder for the project; its name is the project id.

forcing

Data frame of time, rain and pet (mm per step), prepared with align_series(), convert_units() and fill_gaps() or otherwise.

observed

Observed flow, m3/s, aligned with forcing.

area_km2

Catchment area.

calibration, validation

Windows, as for register_data().

structure

Model configuration; by default the standard preset at the step of forcing. With recommend = TRUE, the structure the recommendation starts from.

stages

Stages from pdm_stages(), or a function of the configuration that returns them; by default pdm_stages(structure, overrides, exclude).

bounds

Search ranges from calibration_bounds(), or a function of the configuration that returns them; by default calibration_bounds(structure, overrides, exclude).

recommend

Choose the recharge rule, soil store distribution and groundwater store with recommend_structure() before the stages.

overrides, exclude

Passed to calibration_bounds() for the default stages and bounds and, with recommend = TRUE, for every structure compared.

cores

Cores for the structure comparisons, with recommend = TRUE, and for the starts of every search, which run side by side with the same results (see calibrate_pdm()).

starts, seed, control, method

Passed to log_staged_calibration() and, with recommend = TRUE, to recommend_structure().

catchment, gauge, purpose, owner, steward

Passed to start_calibration_project(); the owner and steward default to the user declared.

report

If TRUE, build the report with build_report() at the end.

zones

1 (one zone), 2 (always two: a fast zone added), or c(1, 2) to compare them as a last structure step, with recommend = TRUE.

...

Passed to register_data(), such as wettest_years, thresholds, highest_gauged_m3s or reasoning.

Value

The project's row of read_projects(), invisibly.

Details

Zones. zones = c(1, 2) with recommend = TRUE adds a last structure step comparing one zone with two, a fast zone added for a flashy part of the response (two_zone_config()); two zones are kept only if better on validation by more than the tie tolerance. zones = 2 gives the structure a fast zone without a comparison. The default, 1, keeps one zone.

Choosing the candidate. The candidate is the last stage, unless another fit in hand scores better on the calibration headline by more than the project's tie tolerance (0.02 for NSE): an earlier stage, or, with recommend = TRUE, the structure comparison's fit of the chosen structure. A final events stage trades a little of the headline for the floods, and a loss within the tolerance keeps it; a larger loss means the stages ended worse than a fit already found, which is proposed instead, with the reason recorded.

Choosing the structure. With recommend = TRUE, structure is only the starting point. recommend_structure() then chooses the recharge rule, the soil store distribution and the groundwater store in turn, each by a structure comparison on this record, and the stages start from the calibration of the structure it recommends. Each comparison and each choice, with its reason, is in the log. It needs a validation window, since the choice is made on validation scores, and it costs one calibration per option compared: twelve in all. The stages then need to suit whichever structure is chosen, so give stages and bounds as functions of a configuration, such as function(config) pdm_stages(config, events = TRUE), or leave them NULL.

Test years need a validation window. The test scores a validated candidate, so a record with test years, or long enough for the wettest years to be held back (the default), needs a validation window. Without one the call stops after registering the data and before the search; give validation, or wettest_years = 0.

Progress. A calibration of a long record takes hours, so it reports as it goes: the plan at the start, each structure step and calibration stage as it begins, each structure's scores and time when its comparison ends, with the time left for the rest at that pace, and, every minute or so during a search, the model runs made so far and the time each takes. Comparisons run on several cores (cores > 1) cannot write to this console, so each structure's progress goes to progress.log in the project folder; open it to follow them. options(pdmS7.progress_every = 0) turns the minute-by-minute lines off, and any number sets their interval in seconds.

Existing projects. A project that already has a candidate keeps it: a rerun only does whichever of the validation, the test and (with report = TRUE) the report are still missing, so a run that stopped after proposing the candidate can be finished, and a report added later. Delete the folder to calibrate again. A project without a candidate, from a run that stopped earlier, is renamed <project>_unfinished_<time> (its log kept) and the calibration starts afresh.

Declare who you are first (options(pdmS7.user = ..., pdmS7.role = "custodian")).

See also

calibrate_batch() for many catchments laid out in folders.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
options(pdmS7.user = "A Hydrologist", pdmS7.role = "custodian")
calibrate_project("projects/beggearn_huish", forcing, flow, area_km2 = 36.7,
                  calibration = c("2010-10-01", "2019-09-30 23:45"),
                  validation = c("2019-10-01", "2025-06-30 23:45"),
                  stages = pdm_stages(structure, events = TRUE))
# Choose the structure on this record first, then run the stages on it
calibrate_project("projects/beggearn_huish", forcing, flow, area_km2 = 36.7,
                  calibration = c("2010-10-01", "2019-09-30 23:45"),
                  validation = c("2019-10-01", "2025-06-30 23:45"), recommend = TRUE,
                  stages = function(config) pdm_stages(config, events = TRUE))
} # }
